$comment: Pinned FFmpeg build for Cutframe (Windows x64, LGPL, shared). Single source of truth: read by scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.ps1, which both local development and CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, release.yml) run.

Source: BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds, a dated monthly autobuild (never the floating 'latest' tag). Retention policy of that repo: the last build of each month is kept for two years, the last 14 daily builds are kept, older ones are pruned. This tag is a month-end build, so it should stay available until about 2028-07.

Fallback if the pin disappears: upload the same zip (same sha256) as an asset of a release in this repository and point 'url' at it. Never change 'sha256' without re-verifying the archive and the licence check.

To update: pick a newer month-end tag (git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds), take the *-win64-lgpl-shared-7.1.zip line from <tag>/checksums.sha256, update url/archive/sha256/version/dlls, run pnpm setup:ffmpeg and pnpm check. Only the 'lgpl-shared' variant is allowed, never 'gpl' or 'nonfree'.
